title: Greetings and wishes
descriptionFa: سلام و خداحافظی، تشکر و عذرخواهی، و جمله‌های تبریک و آرزو.

words.example: Good morning, everyone! Let's start the lesson.
Good afternoon. How can I help you?
words.tipFa: از ظهر تا حدود ساعت ۶ عصر؛ بیشتر رسمیه.

words.example: Good evening, and welcome to the show.
words.tipFa: برای سلام کردن موقع رسیدنه، نه خداحافظی.

words.example: Hello, my name is Sara. Nice to meet you.
Hi Reza! Long time no see.
Hi Mina, how are you today?
words.tipFa: جواب‌های رایج: Fine, thanks. And you? یا Not too bad, thanks.

words.example: How are you? Not too bad, thanks.
Goodbye, see you on Monday.
I have to go now. See you soon!
words.tipFa: خودمونیه. شبیهش: See you later / See you tomorrow.

words.example: Goodnight, Mum. I'm going to bed.
words.tipFa: فقط موقع رفتن یا خوابیدن. وقتی شب جایی می‌رسی، Good evening بگو.

words.example: Goodnight, kids. Sleep well!
Can I have a glass of water, please?
Thank you for your help.
Here's your coffee. Cheers!
words.tipFa: بیشتر بریتانیایی و خودمونیه. موقع بالا بردن لیوان هم می‌گن.

words.meaningFa: ببخشید (برای جلب توجه یا رد شدن)
words.example: Excuse me, is this seat free?
words.tipFa: قبل از اینکه مزاحم کسی بشی. بعد از اشتباه، sorry می‌گیم.

words.example: Sorry I'm late. The traffic was terrible.
You sneezed again! Bless you!
Happy birthday, Dad! Here's your present.
Merry Christmas and best wishes for the new year!
words.tipFa: Happy Christmas هم می‌گن. t در Christmas خونده نمی‌شه.

words.example: Happy New Year! I hope it's a great year for you.
words.tipFa: برای عید خودمون می‌شه گفت Happy Nowruz!

words.example: Good luck in your job interview tomorrow!
words.tipFa: قبل از یه کار سخت، مثل امتحان یا مصاحبه.

words.example: Congratulations on your new baby!
words.tipFa: همیشه با s آخر. برای موفقیت یا اتفاق خوب: congratulations on…

words.example: You passed all your exams? Well done!
